definition.label: Regularized worst-group regret V25 correction
definition.formula: g=employment x allocation-present; merge correction groups n<200 to OTHER; Rg(beta)=mean_g[BCE(zK+Xbeta)-BCE(zK)]; minimize .05*log(mean_g exp(Rg/.05))+.003/2||beta[1:]||^2; pK=sigmoid(zK+.5*Xbeta); final=.75*pK+.25*spline77
definition.rationale: KS gains differ by history coverage while pooled improvements remain small. Test a group-robust regret objective with existing90-coefficient V25 head, preserving dimensionality; distinct from prior global L2 and ranking-surrogate objectives. Group regret baseline avoids prioritizing high-entropy groups solely because of prevalence.
